panels.description: Percentage change in total distance driven compared to the prior period of equal length.

targets.rawSql:
WITH curr AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0) AS dist
  FROM drives
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
),
prev AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0) AS dist
  FROM drives
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND start_date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - ($__timeTo()::timestamp - $__timeFrom()::timestamp)
    AND start_date < $__timeFrom()::timestamp
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN p.dist > 0
    THEN ROUND(100.0 * (c.dist - p.dist) / p.dist, 1)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Distance Δ%"
FROM curr c, prev p

targets.rawSql:

panels.title: Energy Δ%

panels.description: Percentage change in energy efficiency (kWh per unit distance). Negative = improvement (less energy per distance), positive = regression.

targets.rawSql:
WITH curr AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0) AS dist,
    COALESCE(SUM(energy_used_kwh), 0) AS energy
  FROM drives
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
),
prev AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0) AS dist,
    COALESCE(SUM(energy_used_kwh), 0) AS energy
  FROM drives
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND start_date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - ($__timeTo()::timestamp - $__timeFrom()::timestamp)
    AND start_date < $__timeFrom()::timestamp
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN p.dist > 0 AND c.dist > 0
    THEN ROUND(100.0 * ((c.energy / c.dist) - (p.energy / p.dist)) / (p.energy / p.dist), 1)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Efficiency Δ%"
FROM curr c, prev p
